headline.text: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about outcome of QIP 2026 - Special Committee meeting
headline.summary: Bajaj Finance Limited opened a Qualified Institutions Placement on November 11, 2026. The Board approved the issue following shareholder approval via special resolution on November 2, 2026. The floor price is set at Rs. 992.25 per equity share. This price is based on the relevant date of November 11, 2026. The company may offer a discount of up to 5% on this floor price. The final issue price will be determined by the company in consultation with book running lead managers. A preliminary placement document dated November 11, 2026, was approved. This document and application forms are being sent to eligible qualified institutional buyers. The QIP Committee meeting concluded at 4.30 p.m. on November 11, 2026. The preliminary placement document will be filed with the BSE and NSE on November 11, 2026.

headline.text: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of PI 2026 - Special Committee Meeting held on November 10, 2026.
headline.summary: Bajaj Finance Limited has approved a preferential issue of 5,74,25,740 warrants to its promoter, Bajaj Finserv Limited. The approval was granted by the Special Committee of the Board of Directors during its meeting on 10 November 2026. Each warrant is issued at a price of Rs. 1,010. The total aggregation of the issue amounts to Rs. 57,99,99,97,400. These warrants are convertible into equivalent equity shares with a face value of Rs. 1 each. The transaction follows the provisions of Chapter V of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, 2018. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company has informed the BSE and NSE regarding this corporate action.

updates.text: Bajaj Finance Limited has approved the preferential allotment of 5,74,25,740 warrants to its holding company, Bajaj Finserv Limited. The allotment was approved by the PI 2026 Allotment Committee on 10 November 2026. Each warrant is priced at Rs. 1,010 and is convertible into one equity share of face value Re. 1. The warrants are convertible into equity shares pari passu with existing fully paid-up shares. Upon issuance, a minimum of 25 percent of the consideration is payable on the date of allotment. The remaining 75 percent is payable when the options against the warrants are exercised. If the allottee does not exercise the option within eighteen months from the date of allotment, the consideration amount shall be forfeited by the company.

brief.text: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
brief.summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited has secured a significant order from Noida Metro Rail Corporation Ltd for the design and construction of the Noida Metro Aqua Line Extension Project. The Heavy Civil Infrastructure business vertical will handle part design and construction of a 15.1 km elevated viaduct extending from Botanical Garden to Noida Sector-142, and from Depot Station to Boraki. The scope includes building 10 elevated metro stations with architectural finishes. The project is scheduled for completion within 36 months. The order is classified as significant, indicating a value between 1,000 to 2,500 crore rupees. This announcement was issued on November 9, 2026.

brief.text: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Reference to the Financial Results issued by Suzuki Motor Corporation
brief.summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited filed a reference to the Financial Results for the first six months of FY 2026 issued by Suzuki Motor Corporation in Japan on 10th November 2026. Suzuki Motor Corporation reported consolidated revenue of 1,466.5 billion yen for the period, an increase of 16.8 percent year-on-year. Operating profit was 134.3 billion yen, a decrease of 0.6 percent. Profit before tax stood at 156.5 billion yen, down 24.5 percent. Profit attributable to owners of parent was 90.8 billion yen, a decline of 22.8 percent. The company noted increased revenue but decreased profit. Foreign exchange rates and raw material prices were cited as external factors affecting results. Capital expenditures were 87.3 billion yen. Interest-bearing debt balance was 736.0 billion yen. Cash balance was 930.0 billion yen. The filing was submitted by Sanjeev Grover, Executive Officer and Company Secretary.

brief.text: HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Approval from the Reserve Bank of India for re-appointment of Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan asthe Whole-time Director (designated as Executive Director) of HDFC Bank Limited
brief.summary: HDFC Bank Limited has received approval from the Reserve Bank of India for the re-appointment of Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan, holding DIN 00030248, as Whole-time Director designated as Executive Director. The approval was granted via RBI communication dated November 12, 2026. The re-appointment is for a period of one year, effective from November 23, 2026, at the extant remuneration. Mr. Rangan is not related to any other Director or Key Managerial Personnel of the Bank. He is not debarred from holding the office of a director by any SEBI order or other authority. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

updates.text: HDFC Bank Limited has approved the re-appointment of Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan, DIN 00030248, as Whole-time Director designated as Executive Director for a period of one year effective from November 23, 2026. Mr. Rangan will continue at extant remuneration. He is not related to any other Director or Key Managerial Personnel of the Bank and is not debarred from holding office. The bank will seek shareholder approval for this re-appointment.

routine.text: Titan Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Earnings Call Transcripts
routine.summary: Titan Company Limited filed a notice with BSE and NSE on 11th November 2026 regarding the transcript of the Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. The transcript discusses unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Management reported consolidated growth driven by innovation. Titan Jewellery recorded a customs duty gain of Rs. 490 crores, while CaratLane recorded Rs. 46 crores. Normalized margins were stated as 11.1% for Titan Jewellery and 11.7% after adjusting for mark-to-market reversals. A fair value adjustment of Rs. 671 crores was recognized on the Damas acquisition liability. Management noted festive season trends showed strong starts and endings with softness in between due to gold price volatility. Investment buying remained soft, while studded jewellery demand was strong. Lower caratage jewellery adoption continues as a strategic long-term initiative. The board has approved raising Rs. 2,500 crores for replenishing existing borrowing.

routine.text: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the despatch of Notice of Postal Ballot
routine.summary: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited has issued a notice for a postal ballot seeking shareholder approval for a special resolution. The resolution proposes raising funds up to Rs. 5,000 crores through a Qualified Institutions Placement of equity shares and convertible securities. The remote e-voting period commenced on 10 November, 2026, and ends on 9 December, 2026. Mr. R Sridharan has been appointed as the scrutinizer for the process. The voting results will be declared within two working days after the conclusion of e-voting, by 11 December, 2026. The resolution requires votes in favor to be not less than three times the votes against it.

routine.text: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Reminder letter to  shareholders to Dematerialise the Shares
routine.summary: Trent Limited issued a reminder on 13th November 2026 to shareholders holding physical shares to dematerialize them. The company cites SEBI regulations prohibiting the transfer of physical shares since April 1, 2021, and the issuance of new physical certificates since January 2022. Shareholders are urged to contact their Depository Participant to convert physical holdings into demat form. The letter outlines benefits including convenient holding, immediate transfer, reduced paperwork, and direct credit for corporate actions. The Registrar and Share Transfer Agent is MUFG Intime India Private Limited. Queries can be directed to them at Mumbai. The intimation is also placed on the company website.
